behavioral_effects: The site graph is a committed queryable artifact: 42 pages joined page-to-proxy-to-backend, 23 with API chains, 10 consuming the WebSocket exception, and 4 pages with genuinely broken chains - calls into the void at /api/billing (feature disabled), legacy /api/kb and /api/orgs paths, a rag sources clone endpoint the backend no longer serves, and a password-change path with no handler.

Called paths now classify three ways: proxied, server-side (matching a backend route directly, the server-api.ts pattern), or unmatched - the first report draft misread server-side calls as broken chains and query-assembly fragments as parameters, and both artifacts are fixed with regression tests.
compatibility_impact: boundaries.json is a new generated report with a kernel-internal schema; called-path normalization tightened (query-assembly fragments no longer read as path parameters), which corrects rather than changes any contract.
follow_up: The 4 broken-chain pages and their 9 dead call paths are debt-sweep candidates recorded in boundaries.json, not chased here.
Session 7.2 adds ranking and risk algorithms over the joined graph.
limitations: Chains are static: a page calling an API through a mechanism the two regexes do not cover shows fewer chains than reality, conservative as designed.
reason: The chain machinery exists per-invocation inside impact analysis but no committed artifact shows which pages actually reach the backend and which chains are broken; the site join makes the page-to-backend map a queryable structure with a coverage report, the WS exception modeled rather than lost, and unmatched chains recorded as findings-in-waiting instead of silence
risks: The WS-exception flag is text-based (modules naming the endpoint); a renamed endpoint constant would drop the flag silently until the interfaces manifest catches up.
rollback: git revert of the single commit.
security_impact: None. The report names routes, handler files, and module names; called paths are template-normalized literals with query assembly stripped, never values.
summary: Join the site graph and report chain coverage

validators_run.evidence_ref: 285 passed in 119s, includes 7 site-graph tests and the called-path normalization tests
